text: Close your eyes and bring to mind the Devi in today's alankaram.
Meditate quietly for a few moments, then join your hands and bow.
Meditate on Lalita Tripurasundari, the compassionate one.
The verse means: We meditate on the Devi who shines with a red radiance, whose eyes overflow with compassion, who holds the noose, goad, flower arrows and bow.
